pages.title: About us | 666 Tattoo Antiques
pages.metaDescription: Learn more about us at 666 Tattoos North Brisbane and Antiques in Lawnton. With decades of experience and tonnes of goth and cool antiquities.

blocks.text:
We are a unique shop for unique folks. 
We offer different specialty typs of tattoos with a combined expertise of over 30 years, alongside a curated collection of hand-picked antiques that are funky, grungy and different. With both of these passions, we could only top it off by adding a relaxed coffee shop atmosphere and some of the best coffee on the northside of Brisbane.
Our team are well versed in the Australian, and more specifically Queensland, tattoo industry with plenty of experience and knowledge to ensure your next tattoo is the best it can be.

We remain committed to the best experience; meaning we have a tonne of other services and products you can check out while you're in the shop. We stock gift vouchers, merchandise, the best aftercare tattoo products possible and we strive to exceed your expectations.
Get in touch with us now
